description: Route C step 3 / candidate S3 (bean qou-8uxw): exact-in-q test of block-and-bond factorisation for the canonical NON-monotone nucleon word at n = 9 (A = 3). C(w) := q^{l(w)}[2]_q^9 tr_D(w) is computed as an exact Laurent polynomial (integer big-int evaluation on weight sectors of V^{⊗9}, Newton interpolation over Fraction, verified at unused prime powers) for β_free, β_12, β_23, β_123 in the compositions ppn, pnn, ppp, nnn, using the canonical constructor (atom_canonical_crossings → atom_braid_word_3A, bring_color_weighted, intra_order=borromean) with interfaces toggled by multiplicity exactly as atom_bond_product_closed_form_probe does. Δ = C(123)C(free) − C(12)C(23) is reported exactly with its (q−1)-adic order; the ε² truncation is cross-checked against that probe's five recorded input series. NO FITTING; q₀ read only for a diagnostic line; the identity is q-formal. bond factorisation holds EXACTLY at n = 9 on the canonical word: for every composition (ppn, pnn, ppp, nnn) C(β_123)·C(β_free) = C(β_12)·C(β_23) identically as Laurent polynomials in q, i.e. the two-bond word's convention-D trace is the free word's trace times the two one-bond factors, each extracted with the other interface OFF or ON — and each one-bond factor is EXACTLY q·(z_D + d_bond), the Markov scalar of the interface letter (z_D = q³/(q²+1); pp: q⁴/(q²+1), nn: 1/(q²+1), pn: q·(z_D − h(1/2 − δ/4))), which is the gap-multiplicativity mechanism of bean qou-g8i1 made exact at A = 3 and the ∏(z + dᵢ) law that mass_at_3A_proper.atom_braid_word_3A's docstring records to ~1e-60. Scope (b) at n = 9, invariant = the identity itself (exact, interpolated from span+3 integer q and verified at 3 unused prime powers). No many-body term of ANY q-adic order exists on the production word at A = 3; a route-C b₃ must come from a non-chain word class or from outside the trace. The general-A Lean statement (MarkovBondFactor.lean general case, bean qou-g8i1) stays OPEN.
